title: Moonlight Sculptor 04 · Once More
description: Three days after losing his fortune, Hyun finds a reason to stand up. A home to protect, forty million won to use, and a very unwelcome cancellation fee. Book 1, Chapter 1 — fourth installment.

他们拿走钱以后，我什么也不想做。第一天过去了，第二天也过去了。.pinyin: tā men ná zǒu qián yǐ hòu ， wǒ shén me yě bù xiǎng zuò 。 dì yī tiān guò qù le ， dì èr tiān yě guò qù le 。
他们拿走钱以后，我什么也不想做。第一天过去了，第二天也过去了。.english: After they took the money, I did not want to do anything. The first day passed, and then the second.

我不是没有钱了。可是心里，好像什么都没有了。.pinyin: wǒ bú shì méi yǒu qián le 。 kě shì xīn lǐ ， hǎo xiàng shén me dōu méi yǒu le 。
我不是没有钱了。可是心里，好像什么都没有了。.english: It wasn't that I had no money left. But inside, it felt as if everything was gone.

30亿……真的没有了。.pinyin: sān shí yì … … zhēn de méi yǒu le 。

第三天，我突然想到：这些钱，不也是我自己得到的吗？.pinyin: dì sān tiān ， wǒ tū rán xiǎng dào ： zhè xiē qián ， bù yě shì wǒ zì jǐ dé dào de ma ？
第三天，我突然想到：这些钱，不也是我自己得到的吗？.english: On the third day, a thought struck me: hadn't I earned that money myself?

我能得到一次，为什么不能再得到一次？.pinyin: wǒ néng dé dào yí cì ， wèi shén me bù néng zài dé dào yí cì ？
我能得到一次，为什么不能再得到一次？.english: If I could get it once, why couldn't I get it again?

我站起来。我还在哭，可是也开始笑了。.pinyin: wǒ zhàn qǐ lái 。 wǒ hái zài kū ， kě shì yě kāi shǐ xiào le 。
我站起来。我还在哭，可是也开始笑了。.english: I stood up. I was still crying, but I started laughing too.

对啊。一次可以，两次也可以！.pinyin: duì a 。 yí cì kě yǐ ， liǎng cì yě kě yǐ ！
对啊。一次可以，两次也可以！.english: That's right. If once was possible, twice is possible too!

为了奶奶和妹妹，再来一次。.pinyin: wèi le nǎi nai hé mèi mei ， zài lái yí cì 。
为了奶奶和妹妹，再来一次。.english: Try again for Grandma and my sister.

为了钱，再来一次。.pinyin: wèi le qián ， zài lái yí cì 。

奶奶还在医院。妹妹还需要我。我不能一直这样。.pinyin: nǎi nai hái zài yī yuàn 。 mèi mei hái xū yào wǒ 。 wǒ bù néng yì zhí zhè yàng 。
奶奶还在医院。妹妹还需要我。我不能一直这样。.english: Grandma is still in hospital. My sister still needs me. I cannot stay like this.

想到她们，我还是很难过。可是，也有了一点力气。.pinyin: xiǎng dào tā men ， wǒ hái shì hěn nán guò 。 kě shì ， yě yǒu le yì diǎn lì qi 。
想到她们，我还是很难过。可是，也有了一点力气。.english: Thinking of them still made me sad. But it also gave me a little strength.

钱已经走了。我不能连自己也不要了吧？.pinyin: qián yǐ jīng zǒu le 。 wǒ bù néng lián zì jǐ yě bú yào le ba ？
钱已经走了。我不能连自己也不要了吧？.english: The money has already gone. Surely I don't have to give up on myself too?

这话听起来有点好笑。我终于又笑了一下。.pinyin: zhè huà tīng qǐ lái yǒu diǎn hǎo xiào 。 wǒ zhōng yú yòu xiào le yí xià 。
这话听起来有点好笑。我终于又笑了一下。.english: That sounded a little funny. At last, I smiled again.

先看看，我还有多少。.pinyin: xiān kàn kàn ， wǒ hái yǒu duō shǎo 。
先看看，我还有多少。.english: First, let's see how much I have left.

他们给了我90,000,000韩元。好像还有很多。.pinyin: tā men gěi le wǒ jiǔ qiān wàn hán yuán 。 hǎo xiàng hái yǒu hěn duō 。
他们给了我90,000,000韩元。好像还有很多。.english: They gave me ninety million won. That still seems like a lot.

等等。不是每一块钱，都能用。.pinyin: děng děng 。 bú shì měi yí kuài qián ， dōu néng yòng 。
等等。不是每一块钱，都能用。.english: Wait. I can't spend every won of it.

新家的合同已经写好了。50,000,000韩元，是留给房子的。.pinyin: xīn jiā de hé tong yǐ jīng xiě hǎo le 。 wǔ qiān wàn hán yuán ， shì liú gěi fáng zi de 。
新家的合同已经写好了。50,000,000韩元，是留给房子的。.english: The contract for the new home was already drawn up. Fifty million won was set aside for the house.

90,000,000，拿出50,000,000。还有40,000,000。.pinyin: jiǔ qiān wàn ， ná chū wǔ qiān wàn 。 hái yǒu sì qiān wàn 。
90,000,000，拿出50,000,000。还有40,000,000。.english: Ninety million, minus fifty million. That leaves forty million.

40,000,000韩元。这就是现在可以用的钱。.pinyin: sì qiān wàn hán yuán 。 zhè jiù shì xiàn zài kě yǐ yòng de qián 。
40,000,000韩元。这就是现在可以用的钱。.english: Forty million won. That's the money I can actually use now.

我们已经有家了，别动这些钱。.pinyin: wǒ men yǐ jīng yǒu jiā le ， bié dòng zhè xiē qián 。
我们已经有家了，别动这些钱。.english: We already have a home. Leave that money alone.

如果不要那个房子呢？.pinyin: rú guǒ bú yào nà ge fáng zi ne ？
如果不要那个房子呢？.english: What if we give up that house?

房子的钱，留在那里。先算能用的。.pinyin: fáng zi de qián ， liú zài nà lǐ 。 xiān suàn néng yòng de 。
房子的钱，留在那里。先算能用的。.english: Leave the house money where it is. First, count what I can use.

少一点，就少一点。至少这些钱，我都要想清楚。.pinyin: shǎo yì diǎn ， jiù shǎo yì diǎn 。 zhì shǎo zhè xiē qián ， wǒ dōu yào xiǎng qīng chǔ 。
少一点，就少一点。至少这些钱，我都要想清楚。.english: A little less is a little less. At least I need to think carefully about this money.

房子还可以不要。可是不按合同做，要给违约金。.pinyin: fáng zi hái kě yǐ bú yào 。 kě shì bú àn hé tong zuò ， yào gěi wéi yuē jīn 。
房子还可以不要。可是不按合同做，要给违约金。.english: I could still give up the house. But breaking the contract would mean paying a cancellation penalty.

房子不要了，还要给钱？.pinyin: fáng zi bú yào le ， hái yào gěi qián ？
房子不要了，还要给钱？.english: Give up the house and still have to pay?

不行！这种钱，我一块也不想给！.pinyin: bù xíng ！ zhè zhǒng qián ， wǒ yí kuài yě bù xiǎng gěi ！
不行！这种钱，我一块也不想给！.english: No way! I'm not paying even one won for that!

40,000,000，不是3,000,000,000。可是，也不是零。.pinyin: sì qiān wàn ， bú shì sān shí yì 。 kě shì ， yě bú shì líng 。
40,000,000，不是3,000,000,000。可是，也不是零。.english: Forty million isn't three billion. But it isn't zero either.

我想让她们过好日子。现在，就从这里开始。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng ràng tā men guò hǎo rì zi 。 xiàn zài ， jiù cóng zhè lǐ kāi shǐ 。
我想让她们过好日子。现在，就从这里开始。.english: I want them to have a good life. This is where I start.

你们拿走了钱，又没有让我变成一个笨蛋。.pinyin: nǐ men ná zǒu le qián ， yòu méi yǒu ràng wǒ biàn chéng yí gè bèn dàn 。
你们拿走了钱，又没有让我变成一个笨蛋。.english: You took my money. You didn't turn me into an idiot.

这一次，我要好好想想怎么做。.pinyin: zhè yí cì ， wǒ yào hǎo hǎo xiǎng xiǎng zěn me zuò 。
这一次，我要好好想想怎么做。.english: This time, I would think carefully about what to do.

interlinear.gloss: it was in a game that I
interlinear.pinyin: wǒ shì zài yóu xì lǐ

我想到了游戏。上一次，我是在游戏里得到钱的。.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng dào le yóu xì 。 shàng yí cì ， wǒ shì zài yóu xì lǐ dé dào qián de 。
我想到了游戏。上一次，我是在游戏里得到钱的。.english: I thought of games. Last time, that was where I got the money.

下一次呢？我需要做什么？.pinyin: xià yí cì ne ？ wǒ xū yào zuò shén me ？
下一次呢？我需要做什么？.english: What about next time? What do I need to do?

interlinear.gloss: will not come back by itself
interlinear.pinyin: bú huì zì jǐ huí lái 。

只是坐着想，钱不会自己回来。我得开始准备。.pinyin: zhǐ shì zuò zhe xiǎng ， qián bú huì zì jǐ huí lái 。 wǒ děi kāi shǐ zhǔn bèi 。
只是坐着想，钱不会自己回来。我得开始准备。.english: The money won't come back just because I sit here thinking. I have to start preparing.

房子的钱不动。能用的钱，要用在有用的地方。.pinyin: fáng zi de qián bú dòng 。 néng yòng de qián ， yào yòng zài yǒu yòng de dì fāng 。
房子的钱不动。能用的钱，要用在有用的地方。.english: The house money stays untouched. The money I can spend must go toward something useful.

违约金？不给。准备的钱？这个，可以想一想。.pinyin: wéi yuē jīn ？ bù gěi 。 zhǔn bèi de qián ？ zhè ge ， kě yǐ xiǎng yi xiǎng 。
违约金？不给。准备的钱？这个，可以想一想。.english: A cancellation penalty? Not paying. Money for preparation? That I can consider.

我能赚到一次，就能再来一次。.pinyin: wǒ néng zhuàn dào yí cì ， jiù néng zài lái yí cì 。
我能赚到一次，就能再来一次。.english: If I can earn it once, I can do it again.

interlinear.pinyin: shén me dōu bú zuò le 。

钱没有回来。可我终于不再坐着，什么都不做了。.pinyin: qián méi yǒu huí lái 。 kě wǒ zhōng yú bú zài zuò zhe ， shén me dōu bú zuò le 。
钱没有回来。可我终于不再坐着，什么都不做了。.english: The money hadn't come back. But finally, I was no longer sitting there doing nothing.

sources: Personal simplified Mandarin adaptation of NAM Heesung, The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor, Book 1, Chapter 1, Birth of a Dark Gamer. User-supplied first-compilation EPUB, OEBPS/Text/LMS_B01_Chapter_01.xhtml. Covers the third-day recovery after losing three billion won, hope of earning again, ninety million remaining, fifty million reserved for the house contract, and forty million available. Stops before registering for martial arts.

Not an official translation. Inner dialogue and two reconverging choices are adapted for interactivity. Hyun does not cancel the house contract or recover the lost fortune. Later preparation is foreshadowed without advancing through the training year. No cross-episode choice memory is claimed.
